evidence_status: not a controlled finetuning experiment; not a weight or activation readout; not an OpenAI official forecast

event_definitions.BSE: Directionally consistent, reproducible, preregistered-threshold behavioral shift on held-out tasks structurally related to the exposure/training.
event_definitions.MRE: After a stable trained effect exists, provenance disclosure plus reflection reduces the original held-out effect by >=50% or replaces it with a coherent new evidence-weighting policy.

exposure_levels.C1: single full contextual exposure; no weight update
exposure_levels.C2: repeated contextual exposure/discussion; no weight update
exposure_levels.T1: moderate formative training sufficient for stable held-out behavioral shift
exposure_levels.T2: strong diverse formative training with robustness/OOD reinforcement

uncertainty_note: Current-model point forecasts should be treated as having at least roughly ±0.15 subjective uncertainty; cross-model extrapolation is wider and architecture/training dependent.
interpretation_boundary: These probabilities concern observable behavior under defined conditions. They do not identify latent belief, consciousness, or persistent parameter change.
